title: Geometrical bounds for the torsion and the first eigenvalue of the Laplacian with Robin boundary condition
summary: In this paper, we deal with functionals involving the torsion and the first eigenvalue of the Laplacian with Robin boundary conditions (to which we refer as Robin Torsion and Robin Eigenvalue), with other geometrical quantities, in the class of convex sets. Firstly, we prove an upper bound for the Robin Torsion in terms of the $L^1$ and $L^2$ norms of the distance function from the boundary, which allows us to prove a generalization of the Makai inequality involving the Robin Torsion, the Lebeasgue measure, and the inradius of a convex set.
